# Proxy Documentation

> Virtual card issuing platform for AI agents

Proxy provides virtual cards designed specifically for AI agents. Issue cards, set spending limits, track transactions, and maintain full audit trails.

## Quick Links

- Documentation: https://docs.useproxy.ai
- API Base URL: https://api.useproxy.ai
- MCP Server: https://mcp.useproxy.ai/api/mcp
- Dashboard: https://dashboard.useproxy.ai

## API Reference

- [API Introduction](https://docs.useproxy.ai/api-reference/introduction): API overview and conventions

### Users
- POST /v1/users - Create user
- GET /v1/users/{userId} - Get user
- PATCH /v1/users/{userId} - Update user
- DELETE /v1/users/{userId} - Delete user

### Verification
- POST /v1/verification/user - Initiate KYC
- GET /v1/verification/user/{userId} - Get verification status
- PATCH /v1/verification/user/{userId} - Update verification
- PUT /v1/verification/user/{userId}/document - Upload document
- GET /v1/verification/user/{userId}/link - Get verification URL

### Agents
- POST /v1/agents/register - Register agent
- GET /v1/agents - List agents
- GET /v1/agents/{agentId} - Get agent
- PATCH /v1/agents/{agentId} - Update agent
- POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/deregister - Deregister agent
- GET /v1/agents/{agentId}/policy - Get agent policy
- GET /v1/agents/{agentId}/tokens - List agent tokens
- POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/tokens - Create agent token
- DELETE /v1/agents/{agentId}/tokens/{tokenId} - Delete token

### Cards
- POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/cards - Create card
- GET /v1/agents/{agentId}/cards - List agent's cards
- GET /v1/users/{userId}/cards - List user's cards
- GET /v1/cards/{cardId} - Get card
- PATCH /v1/cards/{cardId} - Update card
- GET /v1/cards/{cardId}/policy - Get card policy
- POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/freeze - Freeze card
- POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/unfreeze - Unfreeze card
- POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/close - Close card
- POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/details - Get card credentials (PAN, CVV)

### Funds
- GET /v1/users/{userId}/funding - Get funding addresses
- GET /v1/balances/{userId} - Get user balance
- POST /v1/withdrawals - Request withdrawal
- GET /v1/withdrawals - List withdrawals
- GET /v1/withdrawals/{withdrawalId} - Get withdrawal

### Statements
- GET /v1/users/{userId}/statements - List statements
- POST /v1/users/{userId}/statements/generate - Generate statement
- GET /v1/users/{userId}/statements/{statementId} - Get statement

### Spending Intents
- GET /v1/intents - List all intents
- GET /v1/intents/{intentId} - Get intent
- POST /v1/intents/{intentId}/approve - Approve intent (HITL)
- POST /v1/intents/{intentId}/reject - Reject intent (HITL)
- POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/intents - Declare intent
- GET /v1/cards/{cardId}/intents - List card intents

### Transactions
- GET /v1/transactions - List transactions
- GET /v1/cards/{cardId}/transactions - List card transactions
- GET /v1/transactions/{transactionId} - Get transaction
- PATCH /v1/transactions/{transactionId} - Update transaction
- GET /v1/transactions/{transactionId}/receipt - Get receipt
- PUT /v1/transactions/{transactionId}/receipt - Upload receipt
- DELETE /v1/transactions/{transactionId}/receipt - Delete receipt

### Disputes
- GET /v1/disputes - List disputes
- GET /v1/disputes/{disputeId} - Get dispute
- PATCH /v1/disputes/{disputeId} - Update dispute
- GET /v1/disputes/{disputeId}/evidence - Get evidence
- PUT /v1/disputes/{disputeId}/evidence - Upload evidence
- POST /v1/transactions/{transactionId}/disputes - Create dispute

### Webhooks
- GET /v1/webhooks - List webhooks
- POST /v1/webhooks - Create webhook
- GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId} - Get webhook
- PATCH /v1/webhooks/{webhookId} - Update webhook
- DELETE /v1/webhooks/{webhookId} - Delete webhook
- GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/secret - Get webhook secret
- POST /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/rotate-secret - Rotate secret
- POST /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}/test - Test webhook
- GET /v1/webhook-event-types - List event types

### Policies
- POST /v1/policies - Create policy
- GET /v1/policies - List policies
- GET /v1/policies/{policyId} - Get policy
- PATCH /v1/policies/{policyId} - Update policy
- DELETE /v1/policies/{policyId} - Delete policy

### Rake
- GET /v1/rake - Get rake settings
- PATCH /v1/rake - Update rake settings
- GET /v1/rake/balance - Get rake balance
- GET /v1/rake/ledger - Get rake ledger

### Risk Settings
- GET /v1/settings/risk - Get risk settings
- PATCH /v1/settings/risk - Update risk settings
- POST /v1/settings/risk/preset - Apply preset
- GET /v1/settings/risk/presets - List presets
- POST /v1/settings/risk/dry-run - Test rules

## MCP Server

- [MCP Introduction](https://docs.useproxy.ai/mcp/introduction): MCP server overview
- [MCP Quickstart](https://docs.useproxy.ai/mcp/quickstart): Connect in 5 minutes
- [MCP Tools](https://docs.useproxy.ai/mcp/tools): Available MCP tools
- [MCP Examples](https://docs.useproxy.ai/mcp/examples): Usage examples

### Agent Tools (API key or agent token)
- proxy_status - Check user verification and spending status
- proxy_funding - Get funding addresses and balance
- proxy_card - Create and manage cards, get credentials
- proxy_intent - Declare spending intents
- proxy_transactions - Query transaction history
- proxy_onboarding - Get KYC verification links
- proxy_challenges - Get pending 3DS OTP codes

### Admin Tools (API key only)
- proxy_users - Manage users
- proxy_agents - Manage agents
- proxy_policies - Manage spending policies
- proxy_risk - Configure risk settings
- proxy_webhooks - Manage webhook endpoints

## Webhooks

- [Webhooks Introduction](https://docs.useproxy.ai/webhooks/introduction): Overview
- [Webhooks Setup](https://docs.useproxy.ai/webhooks/setup): Configuration guide
- [Webhook Events](https://docs.useproxy.ai/webhooks/events): Event types reference

### Event Types
- user.created, user.approved, user.rejected
- deposit.completed, withdrawal.completed
- agent.registered, agent.deregistered
- card.created, card.frozen, card.closed
- transaction.created, transaction.settled, transaction.declined
- intent.declared, intent.matched, intent.mismatched
- challenge.requested

## Key Concepts

### Hierarchy
```
Organization (your company, holds API keys)
  └── User (KYC-verified, deposits funds)
        └── Agent (AI agent identity)
              └── Card (virtual card)
```

### Card Types
- **single**: One-time use. Auto-closes after first transaction.
- **multi**: Reusable with velocity limits. Merchant drift detection enabled by default.

### Intent Flow
1. Declare intent (summary, amount, merchant)
2. Get card details (PAN, CVV)
3. Complete transaction
4. Intent matched/mismatched automatically

### Authentication
- API Key (`Api-Key` header): Full access
- Agent Token (`Authorization: Bearer`): Agent-scoped access

### Amounts
All amounts are in cents (USD). Example: 2500 = $25.00

## Common Flows

### Issue card and make purchase
```
1. POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/cards
   { "purpose": "Buy headphones", "type": "single", "maxAmount": 15000 }

2. POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/details
   { "summary": "Buy Sony headphones on Amazon", "expectedAmount": 12999 }
   → Returns { "pan": "...", "cvv": "...", ... }

3. Use card at checkout

4. Card auto-closes after transaction (single-use)
```

### Multi-use card with intent
```
1. POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/cards
   { "purpose": "DoorDash orders", "type": "multi", "maxAmount": 5000 }

2. POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/intents
   { "summary": "Order lunch", "amount": 2500, "merchantText": "DOORDASH" }

3. POST /v1/cards/{cardId}/details
   { "summary": "Order lunch", "expectedAmount": 2500 }

4. Use card at checkout

5. Transaction matched to intent → webhook: intent.matched
```
